body.description:
Discovery deep-dive with Chris Yoon (Regional Manager, Kansas-side gyms).

Agenda, from Chris's email of Nov 4:
1. The Crewlane rollout: only about half of staff use the app
2. How shifts and swaps work across the gyms today
3. Baseline: the June proposal has expired; a fresh proposal follows this session
4. Next steps

body.subject: Re: Re-looking at scheduling for our gyms
body.body:
Hey Chris,

Good to hear from you, and thanks for the context on the Crewlane rollout. The deep-dive is on the calendar: Wednesday, Nov 11 at 1pm Mountain, the invite you already accepted. I've added an agenda to it.

On the June proposal: it has expired and was built on old terms, so rather than send it I'll put together a fresh one once we've been through your setup on Wednesday.

Talk Wednesday,
Alex
